$comment: S0 preamble-collision fixture + SIC runtime schema. Documentation-as-data; the CLI validates against these field sets and rejects unknown parameters. 'generator' is truth-bearing (never passed to the online SIC API); 'runtime' is what the SIC block/CLI may know. All indices 0-based, intervals [lo,hi).

comm_code.rule: must differ from sensing_code unless diagnostic_preset=true

diagnostic_preset.rule: only true to allow sensing_code==comm_code (同码近时延诊断)

sync_reps.note: nominal length; the true start is a swept parameter, not known

template_id.note: shaping template identity for the comm preamble; recorded + hashed

sensing_paths.note: weak target preserved: delay 37, |g|=0.25; post=100 covers it

start_offset_work.note: comm preamble start relative to sensing SYNC origin; swept 0/0.4/8/-8

snr_db.note: on overlapping SYNC interval vs clean sensing energy

isr_db.note: on overlapping SYNC interval vs clean sensing energy; null when no overlap

seed.note: fixed per window; exact rng seed recorded

iq_scale.note: native SC16 single shared scale for all components; record clip+peak

noise_std.note: per I/Q component std; total complex power 2*s^2

frac_model.note: generator uses pchip; >=1 cross case uses bandlimited to break self-consistency

truth.note: written ONLY to truth.jsonl; never handed to SIC

sic_k.note: interferer path count; DISTINCT from demod soft-chip mode

fit_reps.note: estimation window in SYNC reps; 8/16/32 scanned

demod_softchip_mode.note: demod consumer only; not the SIC K

metrics.reconstruction_nmse: ||i - i_hat||^2 / ||i||^2 on the truth evaluation interval; note whether noise included
metrics.sensing_cir: per-tap clean/raw/sic, target complex amplitude, peak shift (work samples), weak-target detection, false peaks
metrics.target_protection: coherent projection / matched amplitude on a fixed target ROI; total energy is NOT target amplitude
metrics.full_demod: per-window status, completion rate, PSDU/FCS, failing stage, timing split by success/failure
metrics.primary_gate: median suppression >= 10 dB AND >=95% windows >= 3 dB; >=95% windows target |amp err| <= 1 dB and |peak shift| <= 1 work sample
metrics.negative_gate: >=1000 independent negative windows; false-commit <= 1%; report count/sample size + binomial CI, no zero-risk claim
